EVGP.description: Evaluation Group Assignment (EVGP). TYPE (PIER or ABUTMENT) together with bPIERCAP and bLINK/LINK_TYPE drive which optional fields apply.

TYPE.description: Group type. Case-insensitive. PIER=0, ABUTMENT=1. Determines applicability of link fields.

bPIERCAP.description: Use pier cap. When true, PIER_ELEM_LIST must be specified (hard-enforced).

PIER_ELEM_LIST.description: Pier cap element list. Required (non-empty) when bPIERCAP is true.

EVGP_COLM_LIST.description: Column list. Each entry defines a named column and its element list.

bLINK.description: Use link. Applied only when TYPE is PIER. When TYPE=PIER and bLINK is true, LINK_NODE_LIST must be specified (hard-enforced).

LINK_TYPE.description: Link type for abutment. Case-insensitive. Wire values: "LINK"=Elastic Link (index 0), "SUPPORT"=Support (index 1). Required when TYPE=ABUTMENT (hard-enforced).

LINK_NODE_LIST.description: Link node list. Required (non-empty) when TYPE=PIER and bLINK is true, or when TYPE=ABUTMENT.
